{{Top|leg}}
The '''repeater blaster rifle''' was a triple-barreled [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].

A [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]], the repeater was the size of a blaster rifle and incorporated three separate blaster barrels that fired in rapid fire succession, laying down heavy volleys of fire. Alternatively, all three barrels were capable of firing simultaneously, producing a single powerful blast at the expense of more energy.
